title: Kong By Zilla Disposable Vape Device
description:
Description
Warranty
Discover the Kong Disposable—offering a refillable, all-in-one design that blends the flexibility of an open pod system with the simplicity of a disposable vape! Engineered for compatibility with any 30ml E-liquid Bottle, it features a 2ml refillable tank and an integrated coil, allowing you to explore endless flavour options and nicotine strengths with mess-free refills.
Refilling has never been easier with the Kong—just twist your compatible bottle onto the device, invert, squeeze, and you’re ready to go. A quick turn of the dial at the top ensures a secure fill and a smooth transition from preparation to performance.
Take control of your vaping experience with the airflow control on the front of the device, so you can fine-tune your vape to match your preferences. The LED screen provides real-time updates on battery life and coil status, ensuring you’re never left guessing when it’s time to recharge or replace your device. When the coil reaches the end of its life, the Kong device’s Coil Life indicator flashes on-screen, eliminating hassle, and keeping your vaping experience smooth and enjoyable.
The Kong Device pairs effortlessly with any e-liquid to deliver a flavourful and satisfying vape. With its versatility and user-friendly design, the Kong Disposable delivers the perfect balance of convenience, customization, and control for every vaper. Enjoy cost-effective convenience, innovation, and versatility in one sleek package with the Kong Disposable!
Refillable Disposable Device.
Compatible with 30ml Chubby Gorilla E-Liquid Bottles.
2 ml Fill Capacity.
650 mAh Battery Capacity.
Precise Airflow Adjustment.
Auto-Draw and Button-Activation.
Rechargeable Via USB Type-C.
LED Screen with Coil Life Indicator and Battery Indicator.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your Device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
DEVICE & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a Device or disposable vape Device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty Devices or disposable vape Devices without their original packaging.
